# All Tiled Up

> All Tiled Up is a procedural tileset generator and autotile map editor for game developers and pixel artists.

## What it does

- Generates procedural materials and terrain substrates.
- Paints autotile-ready maps with Wang, Blob, Corner, ISO, and related tile workflows.
- Supports layered terrain, elevation, ramps, caves, stamps, and prefabs.
- Imports and analyzes existing tilesets and sprite sheets.
- Exports PNG renders, Tiled/TMX data, JSON, and engine-oriented workflows including Godot and Unity.
- Supports touch-friendly editing and local-first core workflows.
